summary.text: In July 2025, Zeldin described an era of limitless AI opportunity and linked American AI leadership, alongside energy expansion, to greater prosperity and jobs. He advocated streamlining permitting and cutting regulations to support the data centers needed for American AI leadership. In July 2026, he said America must win the AI race without asking working families to pay for it.
